name: OP 02 Shield Lock
goal: Locked equipment reward: mission accepted at 5, player now 10
steps: F10 after loading; mission should be ready to turn in at level 5, player 10.
Arm Capture next mission screen; turn in Cleaning up the Berg to Hammerlock. Note mission level, shield level, XP and cash.
Collect the shield, F10 immediately; save-quit/reload, F10. The accepted stage should remain 5; native item variation is allowed.

name: OP 03 Fourth Slot
goal: Fourth weapon-slot reward in low-level UVHM
steps: F10 after loading; player 20, Bright Lights Flying City ready at 16, three weapon slots.
Arm mission capture; follow the turn-in marker to Roland. Record SDU versus class mod/other reward.
Collect reward, F10; check slot four, then save-quit/reload and F10. A different native reward is a finding; do not insert an SDU manually.

name: OP 04 World L10
goal: Native enemy variation, dropped gear, vendors, ammo and money
steps: Equip the provided gear, then F10 before fighting near Three Horns Divide fast travel. Note enemy names/levels.
Kill a few nearby enemies; collect money/ammo and one dropped item, open a nearby chest if convenient; F10.
Check nearby weapon/ammo/medical vendors and their item levels/prices. F10 while the menu is open if possible; otherwise just after closing.
Save-quit/reload, F10. No need to travel far or finish Hunting the Firehawk.

name: OP 05 Level 49-50
steps: F10 at level 49 after arrival/discovery XP finishes. The save starts 5,000 XP below level 50; report if arrival alone still levels you up.
Kill nearby XP-awarding bullymongs/enemies until you reach 50; several kills may be needed. F10 immediately after the level-up.
Owned test gear should stay level 49. Capture a fresh drop or vendor item, then save-quit/reload and F10 with newly spawned enemies.
Hunting the Firehawk was accepted at 49; its saved stage should stay 49 after levelling/reload. No need to complete it.

name: OP 06 Level 60-61
steps: F10 at level 60 after arrival/discovery XP finishes. The save starts 5,000 XP below level 61; report if arrival alone still levels you up.
Kill nearby XP-awarding bullymongs/enemies until you reach 61; several kills may be needed. F10 immediately after the level-up.
Save-quit/reload, F10 near fresh enemies; accepted mission and owned kit should remain level 60. No mission turn-in needed.

name: OP 07 Level 72-73
goal: Native tuning boundary at level 73, OP selection remains zero
steps: F10 at level 72 after arrival/discovery XP finishes. The save starts 5,000 XP below level 73; report if arrival alone still levels you up.
Kill nearby XP-awarding bullymongs/enemies until you reach 73; several kills may be needed. F10 immediately after the level-up.
Save-quit/reload, F10 near fresh enemies; accepted mission and owned kit should remain level 72. Do not select OP difficulty.

name: OP 08 Oasis L10
goal: Scarlett DLC arrival, automatic mission acceptance and enemy/loot scaling below 50
steps: Let the arrival scene finish, then F10 in Oasis. Record which local mission appeared and its displayed level.
Equip the kit; fight only the nearby opening enemies, record their levels and collect a drop; F10.
Save-quit/reload, F10. No need to play through the DLC or finish its first mission.

name: OP 09 Tina L10
goal: Tina DLC arrival and scaling below its normal starting range
steps: Let the arrival story/cutscene finish, then F10 in Unassuming Docks. Record the local mission and its displayed level.
Equip the kit; sample the first nearby enemies and a drop/chest, F10.
Save-quit/reload, F10. Stop if a scripted gate blocks the route; no need to complete the DLC introduction.

name: OP 10 Snowflake L20
goal: Short DLC boss encounter and native boss offsets
steps: Equip the kit; F10 after loading Marcus Mercenary Shop. The local mission is prepared at Summon Snowman.
Follow its marker to the bell/arena and summon Tinder Snowflake; F10 with the living boss visible, before firing the strongest guns.
Use slag/healing and the provided heavy weapons to kill him; take a loot sample, F10. Fire launcher is provided as an option.
Do not slog through earlier objectives if the checkpoint fails to restore them: F10 and report the displayed objective instead.

name: OP 11 Level 80 Cap
goal: Installed maximum-level baseline with OP zero
steps: F10 at 80; keep OP selection zero.
Equip the kit; kill a few nearby enemies, collect a drop and inspect vendor levels. F10.
Save-quit/reload, F10. No promise that every native enemy/item equals 80; preserve native exceptions.

name: OP 12 Alt Reward
goal: Alternative weapon reward and accepted stage lower than the player
steps: F10 in Sanctuary. Rakkaholics Anonymous is prepared for turn-in at 20; player is 25.
Pick Moxxi (Rubi) OR Mordecai (Sloth). Arm mission capture before opening the reward card. Tell us which recipient you chose and the displayed weapon level.
Collect reward and F10; save-quit/reload, F10. Accepted stage should remain 20; native item variation is allowed.
Optional: fully close game and re-copy this test file to try the other recipient. If neither offers a turn-in, F10 and report; do not replay the prerequisite story.
